_comment: CFN parameters infra/config-deploy.sh (config-only mode) may change.
This is an ALLOWLIST (fail-closed): any parameter not named here is
treated as unsafe-by-default and config-deploy.sh refuses to proceed if
a local .env change would touch it. A parameter belongs here only if
changing it can never require a Lambda code/bundle rebuild — pure CFN
resource properties, or Lambda env vars read via process.env at runtime.
ServiceName, Env             — identity of the stack; a change is a new stack.
LambdaPackagesBucketName     — could point the Lambda at a bucket without
